parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg of the pliers, made of steel, forming one of the two handles used to apply force. It is elongated and ergonomically shaped for grip.
parts.Functional_description: The leg provides leverage and is the main part grasped by the user to operate the pliers. It transmits hand force to the jaws for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the base body, enabling the opening and closing motion of the pliers.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, containing the pivot joint and one of the gripping jaws.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the structural core of the pliers, housing the pivot and providing one side of the gripping or cutting surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary relative to the leg except for the pivoting motion that allows the jaws to open and close.
